items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I wrote a thing for Pete Candoli, he asked me who should play the trumpet

ctx.x: One that they made when it was an Army, with -- they made in Europe, and it was a cafe scene in Paris or something, so I wrote a thing for Pete Candoli, he asked me who should play the trumpet, because the other lead was going to play the trumpet .
